wire.headline: Energy firm cuts jobs and plants as profit falls
sentences: Revenue for the quarter to 30 September rose 7% year on year to 4.26bn GBP.
The company will cut 850 jobs, which represents about 6% of its workforce.
Two gas plants, located in Wales and Kent, are scheduled to close by March 2027.
CEO Marian Holt stated that cost pressure has been sharper than expected.
Ofgem has opened an investigation into the company's billing system.
The dividend has been held at 12.4p a share.
